faq.title: French Minecraft Create server
faq.intro: Create France is a French modded Minecraft server built around the Create mod (Create 6, Minecraft 1.21.1 on NeoForge). Players build automated factories, train networks, mining machines and flying contraptions with Create Aeronautics, alone or as a team, on a map shared with the whole community.

items.q: How do I join the Create France server?
items.a: The easiest way: download the Create France Launcher, sign in with your Microsoft account and click Play. It installs Java, Minecraft 1.21.1, NeoForge and the whole modpack, then connects you straight to the server. You can also install the Create France modpack from CurseForge and join the IP play.createfrance.fr.
The IP is play.createfrance.fr. The server runs Minecraft Java 1.21.1 and requires the Create France modpack (installed automatically by the launcher).

items.q: Which mods are on the server?
items.a: The heart of the server is the Create mod (version 6) and its add-ons: Create Aeronautics for flying machines, Create Big Cannons, Railways Untold for trains, plus many decoration and quality-of-life mods. The full list is in the modpack on CurseForge.
Yes, playing is free. All you need is an official Minecraft Java Edition account. The shop ranks are there to support the server.

items.q: Do I need to know the Create mod to play?
items.a: No. The server welcomes beginners: the mod's Ponder scenes (hold W over a block) show how each machine works, and the community is happy to help on Discord.
